maintenance_led.reason: Sells new avionics (flight decks, autothrottles, air data computers) as retrofit and forward-fit upgrades, not mainly repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mostly OEMs, commercial operators, MROs and business aviation (Pilatus, Boeing, DHL); US DoD is only one customer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by designing and certifying its own avionics products in-house at Exton, Pennsylvania; no acquisition activity described.

mission_critical.reason: FAA-certified air data, flight management and autothrottle systems are qualified into aircraft; switching needs recertification and downtime.

notes: Retrofit versus aftermarket revenue split and the government share are inferred from website text only.
